question: Which board columns converge in bulk? reconcile_status walks the whole board and wrote only status — does a row whose description fell behind ever catch up?
instrument: tests/task/test_board_sync.py block 9 (9a-9j), over a synthetic board and store where one card drifts in description only, one in status and description, and one is up to date; plus the live measurement pairing 363 cards against the session rows by subject.
metric: The status and description columns of a store row, read back after reconcile_status(apply_changes=True), compared with its board card; and the bucket each card falls into.
